entry.title: New: Bill 38, CD1, FD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 3.34, MAUI COUNTY CODE, ESTABLISHING CRITERIA FOR THE ʻOHANA ASSISTANCE PROGRAM WITHIN THE HOMEOWNER PROGRAMS REVOLVING FUND" The purpose of this bill is to allow grants up to $100,000 for property owners to build an accessory dwelling or second farm dwelling to be used as a rental residential workforce housing unit.
